_comment: VinX Testnet Genesis Spec — shared by every node in the network.
_instructions: 1. Set chain_id to 7 for testnet (never change after first block).
2. Set genesis_timestamp to a fixed Unix epoch you will announce publicly.
Use: date -u +%s  (or pick any future second — all nodes must use the same value).
3. Set admin_address to your admin key's bech32 address (vinx1...).
4. Set initial_validator to the validator address of your genesis node.
This is the ONLY validator at block 0 — others join via governance.
5. prefund_initial_validator_vinx: atoms of VinX pre-credited to the
initial_validator account so it can pay gas and bond.
0 = fair launch (no pre-funding). Recommended for mainnet; fine for testnet.
6. Commit this file; distribute it to all participants.
Every node must set VINX_GENESIS_SPEC=<path> before first launch.
DO NOT change it after any node has started — genesis hash would differ.
